6.author: lustforlife
6.description: Fixed AI for Timmy's yelling on spawn.

8.author: fathergm
8.description: The Sunken Temple class specific quests are now exclusive so you can only complete one.

0.author: Shader2
0.description: Spirit of Redemption has been temporarily disabled due to players not dropping PvP chests.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Demonic Knowledge has been temporarily disabled due to a bug.

4.author: lustforlife
4.description: Adding a system to prevent High levels from helping low-levels claim High-Risk kills.

4.author: lustforlife
4.description: Sargeras - Players will now drop items from their bag despite being naked.

8.author: kikevin3000
8.description: When doing the Wild Hearts quest, mousing over a worg that drops Discolored Worg Hearts now shows your current item count for the quest, and shows that it drops the item.

8.author: kikevin3000
8.description: Apothecary Berard was severely undertuned, not really tuned at all. He is now tuned to vanilla-like standards.

8.author: kikevin3000
8.description: Fixed issue where Duskbat pelts werent dropping from vampiric duskbats.

8.author: kikevin3000
8.description: Spawned in all of the npcs for epic hunter quests, only one was spawned before.

8.author: kikevin3000
8.description: Disabled the two starter class quests that were left in the undead starting zone.

8.author: kikevin3000
8.description: Fixed "A Rogue's Deal", it now properly gives quest credit when pets kill Calvin Montague.

8.author: kikevin3000
8.description: Fixed additional/out of place pumpkin spawns for the tirisfal glades pumpkin gathering quest.

8.author: kikevin3000
8.description: Fixed a potential issue I noticed with the Dark Iron Marksman "Marksman Hit" cast.

8.author: kikevin3000
8.description: Cleaned up Rise, Obsidion scripts and potential issues, and fixed the issue where Lathoric would despawn before you could kill him (he had a script that was despawning him on evade as a security check, I added an improved security check to obsidion, and tossed in a few other security checks to keep them linked/clean)

8.author: kikevin3000
8.description: Rescripted the entirety of the Stave of the Ancients quest.

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Greatly increased the damage buff from Gri'lek's Avatar.

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Gri'lek should now focus on one random player when he goes into avatar form.

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Added aggro bouncing system to Nightmare Illusions.

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Hazza'rah now has the black visual orb when summoning adds, and their locations are entirely randomized (it was targeting random hostiles previously).

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Added a security check to Hazza'rah in order to keep his adds attached to him.

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Dark Iron Deposits in Molten Core no longer respawn.

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Combed through Molten Core double checking all monster health values and reverting them to vanilla-like standards before scaling.

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Fixed issue with the Dark Iron Land Mines blowing up instantly, as well as issues all around with their AI in general.

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Fixed text received when failing to enter Onyxia's Lair.

4.author: lustforlife
4.description: Found and Fixed major issues expected to be causing daily performance issues from 9 to 10 server time.

4.author: lustforlife
4.description: Reworked Faction-Based Guard AI to be more intelligent. More updates with this coming soon.

4.author: lustforlife
4.description: Fixed bug where FFA flag would turn on before the player was over 20 on Sargeras.

4.author: lustforlife
4.description: Fix exploit where players could autoattack other players in Sanctuaries.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Sweeping Strikes damage is no longer affected by armor as intended.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Berserker Stance crit chance bonus now applies to spell crit as well.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Blade Flurry damage is no longer affected by armor as intended (it was receiving a double armor reduction).

4.author: lustforlife
4.description: Sargeras Drop Items on death equipment has been reduced.

4.author: lustforlife
4.description: Fel Commutation now has additional price brackets to make it significantly more affordable for lower levels.

4.author: lustforlife
4.description: Fel Commutation will no longer require Demon Tears to save your items.

0.author: Shader2
0.description: PvP chest drop level range is now 5 levels.

4.author: lustforlife
4.description: Scroll of Unlearning now has a confirmation box to prevent you from unlearning talents or spells!

4.author: lustforlife
4.description: Reworked Tooltip system, it should update much faster and reflect more accurately now.

5.author: Shader2
5.description: Fixed low level PvP trinket not having a 5 min cooldown (2 min cd PvP trinket exists but requires level 58).

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Grace now increases all healing done instead of only Priest spells.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Divine Purpose now gives 1/2% reduced chance to get hit, down from 2/4%.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Stormstrike now increases the damage done by all your non-periodic spells and abilities dealing Nature damage instead of only Shaman ones.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Warbringer now also increases the cooldown of Intercept by 5 sec.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: All Firestones now increases damage done by all spells by 1% instead of Warlock direct damage spells.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: All Spellstones now increases damage done by Warlock periodic spells by 2%, ujp from 1%.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Improved Barkskin now works with Cat Form, Warrior stances, Shadow Form and Stealth

0.author: Shader2
0.description: All profession passives have been disabled.

2.author: lustforlife
2.description: PvP Vendors for both the Horde and the Alliance have been fixed with their intended Title requirements and items.

2.author: lustforlife
2.description: Ore and Herb nodes in Mulgore should now be on-par with other zones.

5.author: lustforlife
5.description: Murloc Costume can no longer be dropped in High-Risk PvP

1.author: lustforlife
1.description: Resolved an issue with Dual Wield and Titan's Grip not refunding adequate AE/TE

1.author: lustforlife
1.description: Fixed AI on Water Elemental. They should now interact as intended.

1.author: lustforlife
1.description: Fixed AI on Imp. Imps should no longer run towards the target when out-of-mana.

0.author: Shader2
0.description: Agility now gives 1.5 Ranged Attack Power, down from 2.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Fire Power now increases Fire damage by 2/4/6/8/10%, up from 1/2/3/4/5%.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: All traps now share cooldown. (this will get changed into separate trap categories soon).

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Sheath of Light now works with Holy Shock and Penance (finally).

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Arcane Potency will now be consumed by Holy Shock and Penance as intended.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Soul Warding is now reducing the cooldown of Power Word: Shield as intended.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: You are now limited to only using spells while in Tree of Life form.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Wrath of Cenarius effect reverted to its original state. Now makes your Starfire gain an additional 4/8/12/16/20% and your Wrath gain an additional 2/4/6/8/10% of your bonus damage effects.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Piercing Ice now increases Frost damage by 2/4/6%, up from 1/2/3%.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Spell Power (the Mage talent) now only affects Mage Arcane spells.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Arcane Missiles will now put you in combat as intended.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Fixed the issue where Deep Wounds wouldn't proc from abilities with triggered attacks (for example Mutilate and Stormstrike).

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Fixed the issue where traps wouldn't work versus a player from the same faction.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Maelstrom Weapon now works with all weapon types.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Chimera Shot now deals 90% weapon damage, down from 100%.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Chimera Shot - Serpent total Serpent Sting damage changed back to 40% up from 20%.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Seal of Command and Seal of Righteousness will no longer proc on off-hand attacks.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Seal of Righteousness changed back to its original mechanics. No longer has an internal cooldown and now deals damage equal to your mainhand weapon speed * (8% spell power + 1% attack power).

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Frenzied Regeneration is now working as intended.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: All of the single target taunts now share a cooldown (includes Righteous Defense).

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Burning Determination now lasts 30 sec, up from 20.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Rockbiter rank 1 is now attainable at level 10 and gives 24 attack power. Rank 2 at level 22 and gives 40 attack power. Rank 3 at level 34 and gives 68 attack power. Rank 4 at level 46 and gives 102 attack power.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Arcane Concentration now procs from all damaging spells and reduces the mana cost of your next spell (instead of Mage only).

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Honor Among Thieves combo point gain will no longer destealth you (it's what was causing the seemingly random destealths).

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Auto Shot now gives a 15% ranged attack speed bonus as intended (instead of everyone starting with it).

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Offensive damage cooldown spell stacking system improved and stacking rules tweaked. You are now allowed to use more offensive buffs at the same time.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Combustion, Sweeping Strikes, Adrenaline Rush, Blade Flurry, Cold Blood, Inner Focus, Divine Illumination, Berserk no longer shares cooldown with anything.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Icy Veins, Power Infusion and Elemental Mastery (haste buff) won't stack with each other.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Arcane Power, Death Wish, The Beast Within, Metamorphosis won't stack with each other.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Presence of Mind, Nature's Swiftness, Elemental Mastery, Natural Alacrity shares cooldown.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Black Arrow will no longer share cooldown with traps.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Wyvern Sting damage part is now working on players as intended.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Black Arrow is now increasing all damage done as intended.

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Stormstrike no longer has a chance to proc an extra weapon imbue (it could proc 3 times instead of 2 as intended).

1.author: Shader2
1.description: Lock and Load now removes the cooldown of Explosive Shot and Arcane shot as intended.

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Reduced the health values of Jin'do the Hexxer's brain wash totems and shades.

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Changed the nature of Mar'li's spider buff ability, due to issues with increasing its health (would lead to 12K+ heals instead of the intended 4K).

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Fixed issue with Jin'do the Hexxer's Brain Wash totems being neutral.

6.author: kikevin3000
6.description: Increased the frequency at which Venoxis summons Parasitic Serpents.
